summary: Quick PIN Login feature fully tested. Backend: 19/19 tests passed. Frontend: All UI flows working correctly including PIN setup, Quick Login page, and Settings integration.

backend_quick_pin: GET /api/auth/quick-pin/status - Returns enabled status, expiry, last_used
POST /api/auth/quick-pin/setup - Creates PIN with password verification, returns device_token
POST /api/auth/quick-pin/login - Login with device_token + PIN, returns access_token
POST /api/auth/quick-pin/check-device - Validates device token, returns user_hint and masked email
POST /api/auth/quick-pin/change - Changes PIN with current PIN verification
POST /api/auth/quick-pin/disable - Disables PIN with PIN verification
PIN too short rejected (422 validation error)
Wrong current PIN rejected for change (400)
Invalid device token rejected for login (401)
Wrong PIN rejected for login with remaining attempts message (400)
frontend_quick_pin: Settings Page - Quick PIN section loads with data-testid='quick-pin-settings'
Settings Page - Setup button visible when PIN not configured
Settings Page - PIN setup form with new PIN, confirm PIN, password fields
Settings Page - PIN dots indicator shows progress
Settings Page - PIN match validation message ('Les PINs correspondent')
Settings Page - Change/Disable buttons visible after PIN setup
Quick Login Page - Loads at /quick-login route
Quick Login Page - Shows user greeting ('Bonjour, Utilisateur!')
Quick Login Page - Shows masked email (us***@sbpay.com)
Quick Login Page - PIN input with 6 dots indicator
Quick Login Page - 'Se connecter' button with fingerprint icon
Quick Login Page - 'Utiliser email et mot de passe' fallback link
Quick Login Page - Successful login redirects to dashboard
Login Page - Quick PIN button appears when device token exists

critical_code_review_comments: PIN security well-implemented with SHA256 hashing and salt
Device token stored securely with hash comparison
PIN lockout mechanism after 5 failed attempts (30 min lockout)
Device token expiry set to 30 days
Password verification required for PIN setup (prevents unauthorized setup)
All data-testid attributes present for automated testing
Proper French error messages for user-facing errors
localStorage used for device_token storage (sbpay_device_token key)
